decision.bff: full image swissjob-backend:point5-f29fd44 is required for idempotent future profile enrollment
decision.worker: keep live image swissjob-worker:point5-84853cf and apply scripts/deploy_nas.sh worker --config-only
decision.reason: The only executable source change is profile_sync.py, which runs in the FastAPI/Gunicorn lifespan. The Celery worker neither imports it nor registers a task for it. The final 14-provider plus 2-scraper handover is configuration and is exactly the purpose of --config-only.
decision.preferred_order_after_core: apply worker --config-only first to stop its scheduled duplicate producers, then deploy the full BFF image and its same final handover policy
decision.full_worker_candidate: built and validated locally but not required or to be transferred/deployed

supersedes: the earlier conclusion in worker-release-candidate.json that full worker deployment was required for profile delivery
